# AWS Batch job execution

**Status: proposed.** This service or extension is not implemented in the registered API profiles.
The scope below is a design candidate, without an assigned version or delivery date.

## First useful slice

Extend the implemented metadata subset with an explicitly configured execution engine.

## Proposed scope

- [ ] SubmitJob
- [ ] DescribeJobs and ListJobs
- [ ] CancelJob and TerminateJob
- [ ] Scheduler and worker readiness
- [ ] Scheduling policies and fair-share queues
- [ ] Consumable resources
- [ ] Fargate, Spot, EKS and advanced job definitions

## Integration decisions

The current Batch API persists records only. Runtime adapters need readiness, lifecycle, restart and cleanup contracts before any job execution success is exposed.
